_about: Shared cases for how a warning letter's text is laid out. The backend (services/warning_letters.py body_blocks, used by the PDF, the DOCX and the HTML) and the screen (frontend/src/components/warningLetterBlocks.ts) must give the same blocks; tests/test_warning_rendering.py and frontend/tests/warningLetterBlocks.test.mjs both read this file. Each expected block: kind, heading (for a section), text (its lines joined with a newline). The screen also adds the subject from the letter's subject line when the text has none; that is not part of these cases.

cases.name: a standard letter: greeting, known headings, closing line
cases.body:
Dear Juan,

Violation Details
Roaming at night.

Subdivision Policy
Rule 6.3

This warning was issued on November 12, 2026.

expected.text: This warning was issued on November 12, 2026.
